notes.title: Nominate Milo and the Christmas Gift for the Sit Back and Relax Steam Award!
notes.content:
Friends, Milo requires your aid! 🐈‍⬛

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799137/0c8714c24b8ff16a74979b9c4f4854c345e5d614.jpg[/img]

If you enjoyed your time with our cosy, free-to-play Milo and the Christmas Gift adventure, please consider nominating [b]Milo and the Christmas Gift for the Sit Back and Relax Steam Awards category![/b] 🎁 (or whichever other category you find suitable)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716140/Milo_and_the_Christmas_Gift/

Milo and the Christmas Gift is a free-to-play, short, atmospheric point-and-click adventure game created by artist Johan Scherft. It is a spin-off story following the events in Milo and the Magpies. The game has five chapters and a gameplay time of around 30 minutes! 

Not to mention that if you play Milo and the Christmas Gift, nominate it, and leave a review, you’ll get a bunch of shiny Steam badges and Milo's gratitude for your trouble! Thank you all for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44799137/c868fcda1cef27cb49f076e906d51f1e64bb45dd.png[/img]

PS. Our newest addition to the Second Maze family, Follow the meaning, is also up for nomination in the Outstanding Visual Style Award! You can get Follow the meaning, for 25% off -> play it -> nominate and leave a review to get Steam badges, as well as the certainty that you've helped out a passionate indie studio get their debut title to be seen by more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720280/Follow_the_meaning/

Thank you and happy Steam Autumn Sale!

notes.content:

notes.title: 🐰 Milo and the Christmas Gift 🐈‍⬛🎁 Out Now, just in time for Christmas 🎄
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=hr2CqmFLbUE;full][/previewyoutube]

Happy Holidays! 🎉 And what better Christmas gift than Johan Scherft's beautiful new free-to-play, spin-off adventure game which you can download and play right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716140/Milo_and_the_Christmas_Gift/

We hope you’ll all enjoy spending your Winter Holidays with Milo and the Christmas Gift: a free-to-play, short but sweet point-and-click spin-off about our favourite little cat, Milo, who once again needs your assistance! But this time, Milo needs help finding one runaway Christmas Gift! 

A huge thank you to Johan Scherft for once again working with us and giving us the gift of publishing another lovely, free-to-play, adventure with Milo, just in time for the Winter Holidays! This Christmas Gift was wrapped by many talented people: Johan with his beautiful art and creative storytelling, Victor Butzelaar who sprinkled holiday cheer into every chapter with his wonderful music, Jeroen Wimmers who once again worked his code magic,  our lovely voice actors Kimmy Wolfe ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/kimmykims]@KimmykimsPlays[/url]) and GlitchKraft ([url=https://www.twitch.tv/glitchkraft]@GlitchKraft[/url]) who gave life to Yvonne and Marleen, Bob Rafferty who put together this lovely festive trailer and last but not least all our awesome translators and testers - thank you all! 🙏

Please consider leaving Milo and Toby a Christmas gift this year by leaving a review to let us know what you think! 😻 

Thank you all for your incredible support 🐈‍⬛ and a warm Merry Christmas from Milo and all of us at Second Maze Studios!

Ps. If you never had the chance to play Milo and the Magpies, now it is time with 44% OFF during the Steam Winter Sale: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1407420/Milo_and_the_Magpies/
